assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: transparent pixel-art character DESIGN LINEUP for a friendly Korean grandma action game. Primary request: the previous zombies felt disgusting; give ALL THREE charming soft chibi HUMANOID forms. Human heads/necks/torso/two arms and hands/two legs and feet MUST remain, with adult-chibi proportions about3 to3.5heads tall. Rounded heads, cute small dark bead eyes with tiny highlight, small round nose, tiny closed mouth, plump soft mitten hands, soft short limbs and little feet, simple broad color clusters. NO skull shape, sunken eye sockets, visible teeth, protruding jaw, emaciated ribs, tendons, veiny/muscle blobs, claws, gore or long dripping strands. LEFT Z01: normal/slim but softly rounded adult human-shaped zombie made entirely of pastel mint green slime, gentle sleepy/silly expression and only2 large clean jelly highlights. MIDDLE Z02: larger wider cuddly human-shaped zombie made of pistachio/lime gel, round head, broad shoulders, pear-shaped belly, soft heavy arms, two thick legs and feet, small amber bubble inside belly, looks like a clumsy friendly heavyweight, not scary; distinctly bigger mass than normal. RIGHT Z03: real ordinary adult chibi person with warm round face, short brown hair, mustard sweatshirt/navy trousers/cream sneakers, a small smooth turquoise slime hood and coating over one shoulder/forearm, face still mostly visible, cute confused expression, real human body visible underneath. Same right-facing side/threequarter camera and same floor, full body, one character per wide equal cell, plenty of TRANSPARENT padding. Pixel art, crisp stepped pixels, warm dark plum outlines, about26 opaque colors PER CHARACTER, no gradients/smooth airbrush/soft alpha. Pale mint, pistachio, turquoise and warm clothing; no text, labels, props, scenery or drop shadows. Actual transparent background including between limbs, preserve transparent cutout.
